changelog: ✨ Streamlined Clean Phone UI: Instant access to content rows
🔥 Direct HLS Stream Engine: Restored high-speed multi-audio Hindi/English/South streams for all movies & series
⚡ Fixed OTA Update: Direct zero-redirect updater
📺 Self-Contained TVPlayer.css: Forced transparent OSD background, mix-blend-mode: normal, and opacity: 1 to ensure zero hole-punching failures on Fire TV.
🛡️ Embed-Source Protection: Non-playable iframe embeds now sort last and hand off safely to real playable HLS m3u8 streams.
⚡ Decoder Lifecycle Fix: Release WebView video decoder before native ExoPlayer handoff so both engines never fight over MediaCodec resources.
🔙 Deterministic Back Button: Returns cleanly from PlayerActivity with focus restored to the active card.
